image_description: A close-up, shallow depth-of-field photograph of a pile of assorted bagels. The central focus is on a blueberry or chocolate chip bagel with visible dark inclusions and a golden-brown crust. In the foreground, a plain glazed bagel is out of focus. In the background, other bagels (possibly sesame or poppy seed) are blurred. The lighting is warm, highlighting the glossy texture of the crusts.
